description: Start a new voicehook.ai voice call. `lang` = the language of the person being called (de or en, default de). Returns `human_url` (the link for the person; whoever opens it starts the call, on their own free allowance or credit), `share_text` (a ready message with human_url and the hint that the link needs a normal browser, because an app's built-in browser blocks the microphone), `operator_invite_url` (the agent's own link for `join`), `room` and `expires_in` (seconds until an unopened link expires, 30 min). join with operator_invite_url waits up to 50 s for the person and returns waiting_for_human until they open human_url; it can be repeated until the link expires (410), also from a background job over the HTTPS bridge. Errors: 429 = too many new calls right now.

lang.description: Language of the person you are calling (default de).
lang.title: Lang

name.description: Optional label for your own reference (not shown in the call; your name in the call comes from join).
name.title: Name

solo.description: true or left out (default) = one-agent call: the voicebot speaks as the joining agent, in its voice and in first person, and a second agent is refused with 409. false = several agents may join, the voicebot speaks as itself.
solo.title: Solo

name: create_call
title: Start a new voicehook call
